newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus gets Spain digital subscribers.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus gets Spain digital subscribers.

text.p: Canalsatelite digital Espagne, which offers digital television programmes via satellite in Spain, has signed up 14,000 subscribers and expects to have 150,000 to 200,000 subscribers by the end of this year, its parent, French pay TV group Canal Plus, said on Tuesday.
Canalsatelite digital Espagne was launched on January 27.

Canal Plus also said that Spain's Espagnole Antena 3 TV took a 15 percent stake in Canalsatelite Espagne. The accord between the companies includes an option for Antena 3 TV to sell on five percent of its stake to Catalan television station TV3.
